summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload under downloaded Bun
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style _0x identifiers with per-function string dictionaries) and, on `npm install`, downloads a Bun runtime archive from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it 0o755, and then invokes execFileSync on the sibling file math_init.js under that Bun runtime. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line obfuscated blob (obfuscator.io string-array/array-rotate dispatcher, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, numeric/string dictionaries) that is not referenced by the package's declared main (dist/index.js) or bin entry — it is reachable only from the preinstall dropper. The advertised functionality (micro-frontend compatibility helpers using log/chalk/semver) is unrelated to both the setup.mjs runtime download and the math_init.js payload. Fetching a second language runtime and executing an opaque bundled payload under it at lifecycle time is an evasion pattern against Node-only inspection and produces arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at `npm install` time. Shape is consistent with a compromised or hijacked release under the @servicetitan scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
